review.assessment: This change adds a calibration utility module but does not modify any existing execution path or import chain to actually use it. As delivered, the application continues running the original uncalibrated pipeline and will still trigger the reported alert storm.

findings.actual: `python run.py` completes using the unchanged original data-processing logic; raw readings remain outside thresholds because `calibrate.apply()` is never called or imported in any modified file.
findings.defect: Calibration module added but not wired into the execution pipeline
findings.expected: The batch script imports and invokes `calibrate.apply()` with sensor offsets, correcting raw readings before threshold comparison so no alert storm occurs.
